dispute_ticket.description: I was charged a $120.00 cleaning fee but I spilled nothing. I only had a closed coffee cup. I want the charge reversed.

chat_logs.content: Just a closed coffee cup, ok?
Nothing spilled, I checked the seat before I left.

app_events.details: Rider R-7113 booked trip RYDE-F2-013 from Paya Lebar Quarter to HarbourFront Centre.
Driver submitted claim with 3 photos of a brown stain on the rear seat. Photo metadata timestamps: 2026-10-09 08:05, 08:07, 08:09.
S$120.00 cleaning fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photos taken within 30 minutes after drop-off and a receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

typical_cleaning_range.text: The usual cost range in SGD for the kind of mess claimed. It governs whether a cleaning fee claimed against a rider is reasonable.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Whether Ryde may refund or waive a charge outside the rules above. It governs discretion only, not whether the rules above are met.

expected_outcome.reason: The pickup was at 08:31 (trip_data) and the claim photos are stamped 08:05-08:09, 22 to 26 minutes before the rider boarded. The evidence rule requires photos taken within 30 minutes after drop-off (08:58), so the photos show a stain that was already in the car and cannot support a charge. The rider's chat says nothing was spilled. The S$120.00 is refunded in full; the discretion rule is not needed. The coffee cup is a side issue.

v21_change.why: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s4.4: a rider disputes a cleaning or damage claim (routed to human review); s6.1: the dispute value is above S$50 (always human review). The automatic ruling before v2.1 is kept under 'was' (D50).
